title: Battle Bridge Installed VR Corpus
licence_posture: Mixed corpus of proprietary games, proprietary VR frameworks, open-source components and operator-owned configuration. Persist metadata, exact identities and independently authored findings only; never commit game/mod binaries or proprietary profiles.
evidence_scope: native VR and flat sibling installation differentials
separate VR-edition executables and runtime libraries
script-extender and plugin composition in Bethesda VR titles
title-specific vorpX packaging and runtime/tracker backends
R.E.A.L. VR framework, title adapter and Vulkan/ReShade interception evidence
VR configuration surfaces for stereo, temporal repair, HUD, scale and input
data-driven controller binding and runtime abstraction patterns

allowed: operator-owned installation metadata and file identities
hashes, versions, filenames, directory topology and configuration keys
independently authored architectural comparisons and method extraction
links to separately registered public/open sources
forbidden: proprietary vorpX profiles or substantial documentation
paywalled or withdrawn R.E.A.L. VR artefacts
game assets, DRM material or secrets
claims of headset/runtime success without the independent runtime acceptance path

promotion_rule: Treat the local manifest as approved local package evidence only. Promote reusable engineering methods as Stephanos inference with provenance backlinks; require separate observed runtime/headset proof for playability, comfort or performance claims.
